scope: Motion/H67 Q8 dynamic-BN rank-3 arithmetic kernel with one shared 96-slot signed-INT8 main product pool

innovation.name: barrier-phased three-mode product-pool reuse
innovation.phase_exclusivity: FRONT projection/moments, coefficient PREFOLD and BACK folded-left reconstruction occur in distinct epochs around the current-batch BN barrier
innovation.hardware_effect: the FRONT and BACK 96-product datapaths are selected onto one physical pool rather than instantiated as the independent pools measured in M165 and M166
innovation.atlif_amplitude_preservation: BACK returns both the thresholded event bitmap and the signed Q24 nonzero amplitude; a later fc2 stage must reconstruct {0,amplitude} or prove an exact weight/scale fold
innovation.dense_materialization_elided: BACK thresholds in the producer and does not emit a dense 10x16 activation tensor

conditional_capacity_boundary.qualification: arithmetic-capacity boundary only; excludes prefold amortization, BN barrier, controller, storage, fc2, BN2 and accuracy admission

fail_closed_exclusions: dynamic reciprocal-square-root and BN alpha/offset generation
INT8 alpha-times-left and Q24 folded-bias range, quantization, RNE, saturation or checkpoint proof
full controller, BN barrier, SRAM addresses and rank-state epoch storage
rank-3 trained accuracy, PAFT or valid825 admission
fc2 reconstruction/fold, BN2 and residual commit
SRAM macros, physical power, energy, FPS, network or system speedup
